name: Jamie Patel
bio:
Jamie Patel is an accomplished IT consultant with deep expertise in enterprise technology solutions, cloud architecture, and digital transformation. With over 12 years in the technology sector, Jamie has helped organizations modernize their IT infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive business value.

Jamie specializes in cloud migration strategies, cybersecurity, and IT governance. They have led numerous successful implementations of cloud-based solutions, helping clients reduce costs while improving scalability and security. Jamie is certified in AWS, Azure, and holds multiple industry certifications including CISSP and TOGAF.

When not architecting technology solutions, Jamie contributes to open-source projects and mentors aspiring developers through various tech community programs.
